from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPS(BaseModel):
    """Diluted Earnings Per Share data for one company from its 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as it appears in the document")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Signed diluted EPS value (negative indicates loss)")
    period_end: str = Field(description="The quarter end date, e.g. 'March 31, 2024'")
    earnings_type_label: str | None = Field(description="How the line is labeled in the document, e.g. 'Diluted income per common share', 'Diluted net loss per common share'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_data: list[CompanyEPS]
